title: Manya | Agencia de Marketing Digital en Lima

facts.fact: Manya's homepage states that the agency has more than 800 happy clients (vendor's own claim).
Manya's Charla & Chela event on AI is scheduled for Thursday 19 November at 7:00 p.m. at Calle Tarata 150, Miraflores.
facts.quote: Jueves 19 de noviembre | 7:00 p. m. 📍 Calle Tarata 150, Miraflores.

facts.fact: Manya's Charla & Chela event is free to attend, with limited capacity.
The AI-focused Charla & Chela held by Manya is described as its 15th edition.
facts.quote: En la 15.ª edición de Charla & Chela, tres profesionales

facts.fact: A client testimonial on the Manya website states the client would recommend Manya's branding service at 100%.
The Manya Charla & Chela event, its 15th edition, is scheduled for Thursday 19 November.
facts.quote: este jueves 19 de noviembre, en la 15.ª edición de Charla & Chela.

facts.fact: The Charla & Chela event starts at 7:00 p.m. on Thursday 19 November.
The Charla & Chela event is held at Calle Tarata 150, Miraflores, Lima.
The country phone-code list on the page shows 244 results.
The contact form's default phone country code is Peru +51.
Manya describes itself as a 'premium' digital agency, and the form requires the client to confirm its company can cover project and/or monthly retainer costs.
facts.quote: Soy consciente que Manya es una agencia digital premium y que la empresa que represento tiene la capacidad de asumir los costos de proyectos y/o mensualidades para el servicio que necesito

facts.fact: Submitting the contact form requires the user to accept Manya's Terms and Conditions.
facts.quote: He leído y acepto los [Términos y Condiciones](https://manya.pe/terminos-y-condiciones/)

facts.fact: The page's WhatsApp contact widget uses the Peru country code +51 and promises to reply instantly to the number entered.
facts.quote: Ingresa tu número y te responderemos al instante.

facts.fact: The quote request form on the Manya page asks the visitor to state their available budget.
The quote request form asks the visitor which type of service they need to quote.
The Manya website states that its analytics cookies use Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel and Smartlook to collect anonymous information such as the number of site visitors and the most popular pages.
facts.quote: Esta web utiliza Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, Smartlook para recopilar información anónima tal como el número de visitantes del sitio, o las páginas más populares.

facts.fact: The Manya website footer lists the operating company as Manya Media EIRL with RUC number 20606381132.
